rationale: Standalone English public-broadcaster hub; occasional CZ cash/fees colour, low statistical value but cheap to monitor.
Always-on RSS layer syndicating CZ bank/CNB economic items; cheap monitoring, secondary credibility.
Official CNB feed layer is a distinct machine-readable change-detection channel, not just a sub-page.
CNB archive section under an already-monitored parent domain; mine when a series is withdrawn.
Regional English trade press recycling CNB/vendor figures; framing only, redundant for statistics.
National statistical office root portal; core A4 denominator source, track both csu.gov.cz and czso.cz.
LKOD open-data catalogue is a durable machine-readable entry point, continuously updated, not a one-off index.
Documented JSON-STAT REST API for retail/consumption series; highest-value automated route.
Standalone legacy multidimensional database on its own host; needed for back-series exports.
Annual household ICT survey is the authoritative demand-side internet-banking/online-payment series; recurring release page.
Annual enterprise ICT/e-commerce survey covering merchant acceptance side; recurring publication.
Recurring English annual compendium page; low-friction comparable digital/payment indicators.
Continuous household budget survey underpinning cash-vs-card spending structure analysis.
Monthly retail turnover releases on a fixed calendar; standard denominator for card-spend analysis.
Separate CSU magazine host; early-warning commentary on ICT/consumption releases.
Technical NKOD/DCAT-AP docs to mine once when building the harvester; not a recurring signal source.
MF open-data portal with SPARQL endpoint and EET topic area; durable machine-readable publisher.
Governance/publication-plan page under mfcr.cz; URL check failed, re-verify rather than reject.
Annual financial-market development report with cash holdings and market structure; recurring back-issue series.
Quinquennial official financial-literacy/payment-behaviour survey; rare behavioural source, low update cadence.
EET 2.0 technical specs and timelines drive CZ POS/cash-register demand; first-order regulatory publisher.
MPO statistics portal gives merchant-economics context but URL verification failed; recheck liveness.
Sub-page of the state treasury portal; niche public-sector card detail, little recurring statistical value.
Telecom regulator open data, only indirectly conditioning mobile payments/e-commerce delivery; low weight.
SBK card statistics are the core non-regulator CZ card/ATM/POS series; top A4 target.
Member/observer list maps every CZ card, POS and ATM actor; mine once for leads then archive.
Authoritative bank member roster covering ~99% of the sector; one-time extraction of the actor landscape.
Standalone association data portal with monthly/quarterly banking-sector and credit/deposit indicator families.
